title: Verify 'Reset filters' link clears all selected category filters and returns to the unfiltered product list
preconditions: Products page is loaded with at least one category filter active
steps: Check the 'Smart Glass' category checkbox and confirm the filtered result count (3 products)
Observe the resulting URL and product list
expected_result: The page navigates back to the plain https://dev.skyline.glass/products/ URL with no query params, the category checkbox is unchecked, the 'Selected filters' summary is gone, and all 19 products are displayed.

title: Verify 'Reset filters' clears both an active category filter and an active search query together
preconditions: Products page is loaded with a category filter and a search query both active
steps: Additionally enter 'glass' in the search box and submit
Observe the resulting URL and product list
expected_result: The page returns to the plain https://dev.skyline.glass/products/ URL with no ?keyw= or ?product_category[]= params of any kind, and all 19 products are displayed unfiltered.

title: Verify 'Reset filters' link is a no-op when clicked with no active filters or search
preconditions: Products page is loaded, no filters or search query active
steps: Confirm no category filter is checked and the search box is empty
Observe the resulting URL and product list
expected_result: Page remains at (or reloads to) the plain https://dev.skyline.glass/products/ URL with all 19 products displayed, no console errors, and no unexpected state change.
